ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all ultimate shareholders, directors, and authorized representatives against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council (1267/1988/2231), EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions list, and Colombian national lists (SAGRILAFT, UIAF reports). PEP due diligence under Ley 2120 de 2021 and Decreto 830 de 2021, with enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons and negative-news monitoring. Given the medical radiation sector, supplemental screening against INVIMA and IAEA restricted-party databases is recommended.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the Cámara de Comercio (for Bogotá D.C.: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or in plain Latin alphabet without diacritical marks for foreign technical terms; the name must be uniquely distinguishable nationwide and end with the token 'S.A.S.'; neologisms and technical words (e.g., 'XRAY', 'DIGITAL') are admitted if not identical or deceptively similar to existing registered names or protected trademarks.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Financial-sector terms ['Banco', 'Seguros', 'Pensiones', 'Bolsa'] requiring prior Superintendencia Financiera authorization
Health-sector terms ['Salud', 'INVIMA', 'Hospital', 'Clínica'] requiring prior Ministry of Health/INVIMA authorization
Public-interest or utility terms ['Petróleos', 'Minas', 'Comunicaciones', 'Energía'] requiring sector ministerial approval
Words identical or confusingly similar to registered trademarks or to the acronym 'S.A.S.' used as a distinguishing element
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon issuance of the Certificado de Homonimia the applicant must present the constitution document to the Cámara de Comercio within 30 days; if rejected, an administrative reconsideration (recurso de reposición) must be lodged with the same chamber within 10 business days, followed, if required, by an appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 10 business days, both per Ley 1437 de 2011. A alternate name may be reserved immediately to avoid project delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted only as an administrative domicile for registry notifications, provided a physical operating address is declared for DIAN and INVIMA purposes. For ISIC 3250 medical-device manufacturing, INVIMA requires an inspectable physical production site in Colombia; a mailbox-only address will be disregarded and triggers a substance audit and potential SAGRILAFT risk reclassification.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced on-site inspection probability within first operational year: 35%; within 36 months: 70%; driven by INVIMA active surveillance of medical device manufacturers, DIAN fiscal address verifications, and random SAGRILAFT compliance audits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Código de Comercio arts. 98, 110, 353–371 (mercantile registration and corporate governance); Decree 1074 of 2015 (simplified registration)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the municipality of the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed) or Escritura Pública when real property is contributed; filed with the Commercial Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital is required for an S.A.S.; capital is freely set by shareholders. Payment may be deferred up to one year from incorporation unless the deed sets another term. No escrow or bank deposit proof is required for registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board of Directors, convened at the registered office on [date], resolves: FIRST: the initial share capital of COP [amount], divided into [number] shares specified in the articles, is subscribed and shall be paid within the statutory one-year term. SECOND: the registered office is fixed at [full address], municipality of [city], Colombia. THIRD: [name] is appointed Legal Representative and [name] as General Manager, with all statutory powers. FOURTH: the Legal Representative is authorized to complete all registrations with the Chamber of Commerce and DIAN, pay fees, and execute ancillary documents. FIFTH: this resolution is effective immediately and entered into the minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (online portal or in-office homonym certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search request; obtain a certificate confirming no identical or confusingly similar corporate name; reserve the proposed company name for future incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name search application form
Proposed corporate name and business purpose
Identification of the subscriber (cédula / passport)
Notarized power of attorney if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as homonymous or deceptive, file two alternative names for reconsideration; no additional fee is charged for the alternative filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of incorporation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (Notary Public) for signature authentication; alternative electronic signature accepted in the entity's SIMPLE portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the articles of incorporation (corporate name, domicile, purpose, capital, board, liability limits). Have all subscribers sign personally and authenticate their signatures before a notary for paper filings.
required_dossiers: Passports or citizenship cards of shareholders
Power of attorney if the subscriber is represented
Articles of incorporation (documento de constitución)
List of directors and legal representative with acceptance letters
Registered office address and location report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial objection is cured by amending the inconsistent clause and re-executing the deed; identification data errors are corrected by submitting the original identity document and revised signature page.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Commercial Registry and provisional tax entity creation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Mercantile Registry) with integrated DIAN registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation deed and apply for registration through the Chamber's system; pay the registration fee; the Chamber provides the provisional NIT and issues the commercial registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized incorporation deed
Name reservation certificate or homonym certificate
Completed registration form (pre-registration in the virtual system)
Legal representative's identification and address
Articles of incorporation and bylaws (if separate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries a deficiency, correct the document and file a respuesta within ten calendar days; if the deadline lapses, resubmit with late-correction fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive tax identification (RUT, NIT) and tax-presence activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) through the Chamber of Commerce channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the RUT form electronically, indicating the company's tax regime, CIIU activities (3250 and related codes), and fiscal address; obtain the definitive NIT and updated RUT with electronic signature.
required_dossiers: Recent commercial registry certificate
Company's incorporation registration report
Legal representative's appointment document and identification
Proof of fiscal address (utility bill or lease contract)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: DIAN may reject incomplete RUT data; remedy by correcting the RUT online and resubmitting proof of fiscal domicile; an administrative appeal is available within ten working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate minute-book authorization and statutory audit appointment (if required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (corporate books sealing); Shareholders' Meeting for statutory auditor appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open, number, and seal the statutory corporate books (minutes book, shareholders register, and accounting books) at the Chamber; if the company exceeds statutory thresholds, appoint and register a statutory auditor (revisor fiscal).
required_dossiers: Minutes of the board appointing legal representative and officers
Shareholders register and minutes book (pre-bound and unbound)
Articles of association provision on revisor fiscal
Revisor fiscal acceptance letter and professional license
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If book authorization is denied, replace non-compliant books with correctly formatted ones; a missing statutory auditor requires new shareholder resolution and registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos) jointly with the Ministry of Health and Social Protection; local municipality for industrial use and zoning permits
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Sanitary authorization for medical device manufacturers (Registro Sanitario de Dispositivos Médicos) plus Good Manufacturing Practices Certificate (BPM)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) or Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible / ANLA depending on project scale
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas) or Permit of Vertimientos for facilities below national EIA thresholds; full EIA (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) required when emission or waste-handling capacities exceed decreed limits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Resolution 0631 of 2015 (wastewater discharge limits), Resolution 2254 of 2017 (ambient air quality for PM and VOC), and Law 1252 of 2008 / Decree 4741 of 2005 (hazardous waste generation, handling, and transportation)

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the local fire department (Cuerpo de Bomberos) after structural load inspection; occupational health and safety compliance (SG-SST) per Resolution 0312 of 2019; workplace sanitation concept from the local health authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); institutional portal https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Trámites Automatizados) at https://muisca.dian.gov.co; DIAN also acts as the customs authority for export declarations coordinated through the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident-owned Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.): (1) execute the private incorporation instrument and register it with the Cámara de Comercio of the company's registered seat; (2) the Chamber of Commerce transmits the incorporation data to DIAN through the RUES, and DIAN assigns the NIT and opens the RUT (Registro Único Tributario); (3) the legal representative completes the RUT inscription via the electronic pre-RUT process and identity validation (banking credential or notarial biometric check), obtaining the definitive RUT with tax classification codes 01 (manufacturer), 36 (VAT responsible), 37 (exporter), and 48 (self-withholder) as applicable; (4) update the RUT to incorporate the habitual export activity and the ISIC 3250 medical-device activity before the first despatch; (5) register as an exporter with DIAN in the Registro de Exportadores and, for medical radiology goods, obtain the INVIMA sanitary registration or export certificate; (6) contract the foreign-exchange intermediary bank (intermediario del mercado cambiario) to receive export proceeds and evidence future reintegro de divisas.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident (Article 12-1 Tax Statute) because it is incorporated under Colombian private law; it is subject to national corporate income tax at 35% for tax year 2024 on worldwide income, plus a 3% surtax on taxable income exceeding 300,000 UVT during tax years 2024-2027, municipal ICA tax, and the national consumption and carbon taxes where applicable. No income is passed through to shareholders; profits distributed to foreign shareholders are subject to additional dividend withholding at 10% for 2024 and 7.5% for tax years 2025-2027. Branches of foreign entities are taxed at the 39% branch-profits rate, but the standard S.A.S. remains entity-level taxed with no pass-through election.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box pass-through election exists in Colombia; classification by entity type is mandatory. Available statutory elections include: (a) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (Simplified Tax Regime, Articles 903-916 E.T.) elective for qualifying S.A.S. entities with gross annual income at or below 107,500 UVT (COP 5,059,487,500 for 2024), consolidating income tax, VAT, and ICA into a single monthly payment; (b) the Colombian Holding Company (CHC) regime election under Article 883 E.T. for qualifying holding entities, offering a 0% or 1% dividend withholding rate at the CHC level; (c) optional group aggregation for economic groups under Law 2277/2022 allowing joint filing of certain tax returns; (d) the foreign tax credit election against creditable foreign taxes; (e) acceleration and expensing options for fixed assets used in medical-device manufacturing under Article 689 E.T. and sectoral decrees; and (f) transfer-pricing documentation simplification for SMEs. Hybrid mismatch elections are expressly unavailable: Law 2277/2022 inserts anti-hybrid rules that deny deductions to the extent the same payment is deductible or non-taxable in the counterparty jurisdiction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.extra_notes_on_registration: The NIT is the single statutory tax ID, formatted with a 9-digit core, check digit and suffix for branches. The RUT serves as the unified tax registration certificate for income tax, VAT, customs, and ICA, and must be kept updated within 10 business days of any change in activities, address, legal representation, or shareholder status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — Colombian Value Added Tax governed by Articles 420 to 511 of the Tax Statute and Decree 1625/2016; export of goods is treated as outside the charge (excluido del IVA) and export of services as zero-rated with refund entitlement; supplementary national consumption tax applies to specific goods and municipal ICA tax applies to industrial and commercial activities, neither of which is creditable against IVA.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general economic threshold for mandatory VAT registration exists: any entity habitually selling taxable goods or services must register as a VAT responsible party (Responsable de IVA) from the first transaction. The former small-trader exclusion below 3,500 UVT (COP 164,727,500 for tax year 2024) does not apply to ISIC 3250 manufacturing, so the S.A.S. is categorically obliged to register regardless of turnover. However, an S.A.S. with gross annual income at or below 107,500 UVT (COP 5,059,487,500 for tax year 2024) may elect the Régimen Simple de Tributación, which simplifies VAT compliance, and exporters must register with DIAN's exporter registry without any de minimis threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Electronic Invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Venta — FEV) applies to all S.A.S. sales and export transactions: each invoice must be transmitted in real time to DIAN's Sistema de Facturación Electrónica (SFE) through an authorized technology provider (Proveedor Tecnológico) or DIAN's direct web-service API. After successful validation, DIAN generates the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS digital stamp and the QR code for public online verification (https://cfe.dian.gov.co). Invoices that fail validation have no fiscal effects, require an adjustment note within two calendar days, and trigger per-invoice fines under Article 652-17 of the Tax Statute. There is no physical fiscal-stamp machine in Colombia; the CUFE validation stamp functions as the equivalent fiscal clearance. Export FEVs must include the DEX number, the customs departure modality, and must be transmitted no later than the date of shipment, alongside periodic aggregate reports required by DIAN Resolution 000165/2023.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The S.A.S. may claim a zero IVA rate (0%) on export sales of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors where: (i) the buyer is a non-resident entity without Colombian tax domicile; (ii) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory through an authorized customs post; (iii) a Declaración de Exportación (DEX) is filed and accepted by DIAN before departure; (iv) the goods are despatched within the term authorized by DIAN (generally 30 days, extendable in justified circumstances); (v) the export proceeds are received through a Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary within the statutory term of 180 days from the due date and credited to the exchange market; (vi) the related services embedded in the export (installation, calibration, technical support, software loading) are eligible only to the extent the service is used exclusively abroad or is directly linked to the exported goods under Decree 1669/2014; and (vii) the entity holds the applicable INVIMA export/sanitary certificate for the medical radiation equipment. Failure to satisfy any element converts the transaction into a domestic taxable sale subject to 19% IVA, plus fines and interest.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) accepted by DIAN through VUCE, containing the export registration number, ISIC/HS goods description, quantity, FOB value, and destination country.
Bill of Lading (sea), Air Waybill (air), or Carta de Porte (land) evidencing effective exit of the goods from Colombian customs territory and arrival at the agreed destination.
Final Commercial Invoice (Factura Comercial) matching the DEX, including HS codes, INCOTERMS, unit prices, foreign-buyer details, and the FEV number from the electronic invoicing system.

Inward Remittance Certificate and foreign-exchange records issued by the Colombian intermediary bank (Comprobante de Liquidación de Divisas) demonstrating receipt of the export sale proceeds in convertible currency within the 180-day deadline.

INVIMA export authorization or Certificate of Free Sale for the medical radiology equipment, packing list, certificate of origin when preferential tariff treatment is claimed, and the technical data sheet retained for DIAN and INVIMA inspection.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN conducts automated cross-checking of the FEV, DEX, cargo manifests, carrier records, and the bank-channel data (SIEX/CRUCE) for every zero-rated export. If discrepancies are detected, DIAN may within the general five-year statute of limitations (Article 505 E.T., extended to ten years for unregistered or fictitious export transactions) retroactively reclassify the sale as domestic and assess: (i) the omitted 19% IVA on the full export price; (ii) monthly default interest from the date of filing of the zero-rated return; (iii) a penalty under Article 648 E.T. equal to 100% of the omitted tax, increased to 200% where the falsity involves the customs exit documents; (iv) additional per-invoice electronic-invoicing fines under Article 652-17 E.T.; and (v) fines under the foreign-exchange regime (Law 1931/2018 and Circular Regulatoria DCIN-83) for failure to repatriate or to sell export proceeds in the exchange market, with maximum penalties per operation that can reach COP 2,500,000,000. Criminal consequences apply where the false documentation is used to justify repatriation of non-export capital or to evade taxes: tax evasion under Law 1778/2016 carries imprisonment of 48 to 108 months, and money-laundering exposure under Law 1762/2015 adds a separate penalty when export documents are used to launder proceeds. Repeated requests for extension of the 180-day repatriation deadline increase audit scrutiny and may trigger automatic cross-examination of the underlying export contracts and carrier confirmations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) — the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República, the Foreign Exchange Regulation Department, operating in conjunction with the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) for foreign trade and exchange verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a flexible exchange-rate and free-convertibility system under Law 9 of 1991 and Resolution No. 8 of 2000 (the Exchange Regime). Current-account operations, including trade in goods and services, royalties, dividends, interest, and compensation, are freely convertible when transacted through the 'mercado cambiario' (authorized foreign exchange market) using commercial banks or exchange houses. Capital-account operations, including foreign direct investment in the SAS, external credit, and investments abroad, are permitted but are subject to tracking and mandatory registration with Banco de la República via the relevant 'Declaración de Cambio' and, for direct investment, prior or contemporaneous registration of the investment under Form No. 5 (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales). Profit remittance hurdles are administrative: the foreign investment must be registered, the dividend must be declared at a shareholders' meeting, the payment must be made through an authorized FX intermediary with a channeling receipt, and withholding tax must be paid at the rate corresponding to the level of corporate tax borne by the profits (5% to 35%, with possible treaty protection). No quantitative limits apply to remittances, but failure to register or channel triggers fines, unavailability of foreign currency, and deferred tax consequences.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Resolution 8/2000 and supplementary Banco de la República circulars (notably DODM-83), exporters of goods must channel the foreign currency from each export into Colombia through an authorized FX intermediary within the payment term of the sale, but in any event within six months from the export date (shipment or leaving the country); services exports may be received within up to twelve months. The entire collectible amount must be either monetized into Colombian pesos by selling the exchange to the intermediary or, alternatively, retained in a 'cuenta de compensación' or applied to permissible foreign-currency obligations, with no free floating of export dollars without a special central-bank authorization. There is no historical fixed percentage surrender requirement; the full invoice value must be canalized within the prescribed window, and a 'Constancia de Canalización' (exchange-negotiation certificate) must be obtained from the bank for each operation. Non-compliance may cause fines, inability to use the exchange regime, and customs penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente in COP and USD, with FX channeling)
Capital Escrow / Investment Registration Account (Cuenta de Ahorros for foreign capital and dividend outflow)
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente and Foreign Currency Account) for trade settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low-to-Medium as a primary treasury solution. Colombian exchange law and the Superintendencia Financiera require resident entities to channel cross-border payments and export proceeds through authorized domestic intermediaries. Offshore digital e-money institutions (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Mercury) cannot substitute for the mandatory local FX channeling, may not accept export proceeds for Colombia, and their use for shareholder capital injection is not recognized for Banco de la República registration. Such EMIs are acceptable only for ancillary, low-value operational disbursements (e.g., software subscriptions) where the beneficiary can be invoiced and the payment is not a Colombian-regulated FX operation. The main operating account must be held with a locally licensed bank. Cross-border fintech corridors that partner with licensed Colombian banks (e.g., via PSE/ACH) can be used for inbound client payments but are still subject to FX channeling rules.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a newly formed Colombian S.A.S., the legal representative or a designated apoderado with notarized and apostilled power-of-attorney must usually attend an in-person KYC interview at the financial institution's branch or via a high-security videoconference made available by the bank, depending on the entity's risk profile. Foreign beneficial owners are not required to travel to Colombia if they provide certified passport copies, a notarized private document, apostilled legalization, and a professional or source-of-funds reference. Physical presence is effectively mandatory for the person executing the account agreement (i.e., the statutory representative or his or her local agent) but may be performed at the bank's office in Bogotá or Medellín within 30 days of account opening; remote onboarding is acceptable only where the bank has adopted digital KYC in compliance with Circular Externa 004/2022 and the electronic signature has legal equivalence under Law 527/1999.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity — ultimate beneficiaries are non-resident shareholders residing outside Colombia (e.g., EU or North America); bank requests full legal-entity tree and source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized declaration of beneficial ownership (Formato de Sociedades) identifying ultimate natural persons; certified certificate of incorporation and bylaws of CO_SAS; corporate registry certificate (Cámara de Comercio) with NIT and statutory representatives; audited financial statements of the parent or beneficial owner; three months bank statement showing source of initial capital; no adverse media check summary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business scope reference to X-ray and digital X-ray flat panel detection equipment may trigger medical-device and export-control filters under product classification reviews.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: INVIMA sanitary registry or medical notification certificate (Registro Sanitario / Notificación Sanitaria) confirming the equipment is a Class II/III medical device; FDA or CE marking evidence; product specifications and intended-use statement; supplier and end-customer export declarations; ISO 13485 certificate; bill of materials confirming no controlled dual-use components; Colombian HS classification (9022 or 9018) and prior DIAN customs rulings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusually high export invoice values to Latin American distributors without substantial credit history, plus need for documentary credit or prepayment financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed OEM and distribution agreements; commercial sales proforma and final invoices; letters of intent from anchor buyers; comprehensive business plan and financial projections; evidence of required license (if applicable) under Colombia's INVIMA import-export controls; compliance policy for anti-corruption and trade sanctions; corporate risk indemnity undertaking and bank guarantee from the foreign parent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The SAS must receive the foreign equity contribution as a plain SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for credit to the account) remittance to an authorized local commercial bank account. The wire must clearly reference 'Direct Investment in Colombia — Equity Contribution (CO_SAS)' and be accompanied by the shareholders' contribution resolution and the registration number previously obtained or shortly filed using Form No. 5. The bank will assign the operation a Declaración de Cambio code; under the Banco de la República's table of operations, the concept code for direct investment in Colombia is typically Concepto 3620 (capital contribution), and the exact code must be confirmed with the bank to avoid recharacterization as external credit. The receiving bank must issue the Constancia de Canalización; funds are converted to COP or placed in a USD account subject to FX reporting. For amounts equal to or exceeding USD 100,000 (or COP equivalent), registration with the central bank's Registro de Inversiones Internacionales must be completed within 30 calendar days of the transaction; failure to do so will render subsequent profit remittances and disposition of assets non-channelable, causing fines and withholding surcharges.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for procurement of goods and services (e.g., amorphous silicon deposition equipment, cesium iodide screens, electronic components) are executed through authorized banks using SWIFT MT103 for open-account settlement, advance payments, and intercompany transactions, supported by compliant Declaración de Cambio forms for imports of goods. For larger or deferred shipments, use commercial documentary letters of credit under UCP600 (SWIFT MT700) or standby LCs to secure milestone payments. Importers must present the import declaration (Declaración de Importación), commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, and proof of payment; the bank may require a Registro de Endeudamiento Externo for deferred credit terms exceeding 180 days. For export disbursements, the SAS should consider bank-backed factoring or forfaiting rather than cross-border EMI solutions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP forwards (OTC, with authorized Colombian banks)
FX swaps (USD/COP swaps with local counterparties)
FX options (European put/call options and zero-cost collars)

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) limited to hedging eligible underlying export or import exposure, executed through a local authorized bank with mandatory recording in the Banco de la República's foreign-exchange derivative reports

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) with updated company data, directors, legal representatives, and UBO information if changed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce in the SAS's registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a Chamber late-payment surcharge plus increased tariff for the year; continued non-renewal blocks issuance of commercial registry certificates, prevents legal operations, and may lead to administrative strike-off of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certified annual financial statements, management report (if required), and shareholders' approval act (Acta de Asamblea / written shareholders' decision), deposited in the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal; additionally Superintendencia de Sociedades if the SAS is supervised
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve financial statements within three months of fiscal year-end; for a December 31 year-end, approval deadline is March 31 of the following year, with deposit at the Chamber within the period prescribed by Chamber rules after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit financial statements may result in administrative fines by the Chamber or Superintendency of Companies, rejection of corporate registration requests, inability to certify accounts, and possible judicial or administrative enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF) annual confirmation / update of ultimate beneficial ownership information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — RBF module / RUT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial registration within one month of incorporation or RUT registration; update within one month after any shareholding or UBO change; confirm current information in the annual information-reporting cycle (i.e., exogenous information return where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late, incomplete, or inaccurate UBO registration or update may attract monetary fines under Colombian tax rules, suspension of RUT-related procedures, and impediments to issuing or renewing corporate and tax certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A S.A.S. must appoint an independent statutory auditor (revisor fiscal) if, at the prior year-end, gross assets exceed 5,000 SMLMV or gross annual income exceeds 3,000 SMLMV; mandatory also where the company is covered by special legal, financial, or sectoral rules, has more than 50 shareholders, or where the articles of incorporation voluntarily require it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (Decreto 2420 de 2015, as amended); a typical non-listed S.A.S. applies Grupo 2 NIIF para PYMES, unless it qualifies as Grupo 3 micro-entity or must apply full IFRS under Grupo 1 classification.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Colombian law does not require a distinct standalone annual UBO filing for all SAS entities. The SAS must keep its share-transfer ledger current, record every share transfer in the Register of Members before recognizing voting or dividend rights, and update the DIAN Registro de Beneficiarios Finales within one month after any UBO change. If no ownership change occurs, UBO data is reconfirmed as part of the annual commercial-registry renewal and the DIAN annual information-reporting cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives (Registro de Junta Directiva / Representación Legal)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – 1,500 per year for registered office / registered agent services in major Colombian cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 8,500 for a mid-size S.A.S. requiring certified financial statements; higher if full revisor fiscal and IFRS Group 2 reporting apply

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 20% preferential CIT rate for qualifying Zona Franca users; 25% incremental deduction for approved Science, Technology, and Innovation (CTeI) investments under Article 158-1 ET; 30% notional deduction for productive fixed asset acquisitions for 2023-2025 under Article 158-II ET; Colombian Holding Company (CHC) regime, which exempts foreign-source dividends received by qualifying holding SAS subject to real economic substance conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: DIAN Form 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) filed electronically through the DIAN MUSCA/Servicios Informáticos Electrónicos portal with a valid digital certificate.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Deadline set by DIAN resolution according to the last two digits of the taxpayer's NIT; for calendar-year-end taxpayers, Form 110 is generally due between August and September of the immediately following fiscal year. Non-calendar-year-end taxpayers follow the same NIT-based calendar adjusted to the eighth month after fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: NIT and full registered corporate name of the SAS
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian NIT assigned to the branch or permanent establishment; do not use the foreign parent's tax identification number

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, including costs of DR detector components and vapor deposition consumables
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only costs directly supported by import declarations, invoices, and customs records; cross-border intangible or component purchases must be at arm's length and supported by TP documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary net income (renta líquida ordinaria) after allowable deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute under Colombian source rules; expenses paid to foreign related parties are deductible only if withholding tax was applied and TP documentation exists
Offset losses only up to the 12-year statutory carryforward period; evidence of the loss year and compliance with Article 147 ET must be retained

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income (renta líquida gravable) after exemptions and final loss adjustment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reductions attributable to treaty-protected activities or CHC exemptions require the relevant DTA/TRC documentation to be filed

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 35% assessed on taxable net income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim foreign tax credits only when a DTA or domestic unilateral credit is expressly available; otherwise full 35% applies to Colombian-source income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance: tax payable or refund/saldo a favor after withholdings and prepayments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a refund results from excess WHT or tax credits, verify the cross-border bank account details and the need for a 'devolución' process with DIAN

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of the tax assessed per month or fraction of month, capped at 100% of tax due; minimum sanction of 10 UVT (approx. COP 424,120 for 2023) when no tax is due; default interest accrues daily on unpaid tax at the DIAN lending rate until full settlement.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders from profits already subject to 35% CIT; an additional 35% withholding applies to distributed profits that were exempt at the corporate level (e.g., non-taxable exchange gains or Zona Franca earnings).
